newsitem.title: USA: Medcross files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Medcross files for stock offering.

text.p: Medcross Inc, which will soon be renamed I-Link Inc, said on Wednesday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission on behalf of selling shareholders, including certain officer and directors.
The securities are being registered under rights previously granted by the company, Medcross said.

The securities included in the registration statement include: 9,384,461 shares of previously issued and outstanding common stock; 6,230,342 shares of common stock issuable upon conversion of certain outstanding securities; and 970,000 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of warrants and options, the company said.
Medcross said the registration statement also relates to the offer and sale of outstanding warrants to purchase an aggregate of 870,000 shares of common stock.
